Use the compact plan operators below. They are generic operations, not predefined business rules.

For a relation join, source is a column of the current outer/event row, target is a column of the related row.

row_check: select.filter IS the firing condition; every selected row fires, so an empty filter is not justified.

relation_check: select,related:{select,join},violation.
required_match_missing fires only when the required related match is absent;
match_present fires only when the specified forbidden/diagnostic related match EXISTS;
match_not_exactly_one fires when a required exact-one relationship does not have exactly one match.
dependency_order: select,link,parent_end,child_start,allow_equal. Link source identifies current row's predecessor;
target identifies the predecessor row in the SAME table. Fires only when predecessor completion is too late.
A null source link is not an active dependency. Use only with documented execution ordering and verified clocks/units.
unexplained_event: select,context:{select,join},explained_by:[{select,join}].
Root select is the event needing review. Context links this event to its qualifying parent.
Fires when the context qualifies and NONE of the documented explanation relations exists.
Every relation source is a column of the ROOT EVENT, target is a column of the related row.
Encode all documented normal handling/retry exceptions through those relations, not only in prose.
Use actual parent/context key joins for explanations too; a recovery in another transaction does not explain this event.
No arbitrary code/SQL. Null/unknown is never silently false. Require complete capture for absence-based conclusions.

Logical completeness review:
Every select.filter array is a CONJUNCTION: every atom must hold for a row to fire.
Separately required facts are not necessarily conjunctive violations. If a document
requires BOTH A and B, violation is NOT A OR NOT B, not NOT A AND NOT B. The current
filter language has no OR within one array: express independently sufficient
violations as separate candidates, whose alerts are combined by OR. Do not silently
weaken a requirement merely to fit it into one candidate. The same De Morgan logic
applies to permitted alternatives and to explanation relations.
For each multi-atom filter, mentally vary one fact while retaining the other facts:
does the calculated firing condition still represent the cited meaning? A current
all-valid sample cannot establish that a logically incomplete detector is correct.
Keep only conditions actually supported by the supplied source. Do not invent an
obligation merely because its violation would be representable.

again for the identical fact already explicitly provided. Capture completeness is
evidence about observation coverage, not an assertion that a business obligation
exists. Distinguish missing business meaning from missing source coverage.

calculation: a known null in an observed row can itself violate that explicit

row_check: select.filter IS the firing condition; every selected row fires, so an empty filter is not justified.

relation_check: select,related:{select,join},violation.

Design justified logical checks from the supplied schema, documents and records.
Select the purpose, actual columns, joins, predicates, exceptions and HR/SR role yourself.
No correct rule, target operator or target condition is supplied. Return 0..4 concise candidates.
Use documented meaning, never rarity, sample identifiers, or a supplied percentile.
HR requires an explicit verified requirement/prohibition. A precisely described operational-review
diagnostic may be observed_SR_candidate when it is NOT an assertion of a forbidden business outcome.
Permitted behavior is not a violation. A permission-only example does not authorize its converse or a stricter requirement.
A CLOSED enumerated allowed-value domain is itself a reusable constraint even when the sample is valid.
Missing required semantic/capture evidence => request_evidence, plan=null, specific needed facts.
Executable candidates have needed=[]; it is NOT a source-column list or an applicability list.
Quote exact source text. These controlled documents are NOT real company policies.
Use the compact plan operators below. They are generic operations, not predefined business rules.
Every select is {table,filter:[atoms]}; atoms are ANDed. An atom is {column,op,value};
op eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge/in/not_in/is_missing/is_present. in/not_in uses a list, missing/present uses null value.
For a relation join, source is a column of the current outer/event row, target is a column of the related row.
Multiple joins are ANDed. Never substitute a list of the sample IDs for a source relationship.
Plans:
row_check: select.filter IS the firing condition; every selected row fires, so an empty filter is not justified.
duplicate_key: select,keys. Fires for repeated composite keys within the selected population. Same key components
in a different grouping context are not duplicates unless the whole scoped key is equal.
relation_check: select,related:{select,join},violation.
required_match_missing fires only when the required related match is absent;
match_present fires only when the specified forbidden/diagnostic related match EXISTS;
match_not_exactly_one fires when a required exact-one relationship does not have exactly one match.
dependency_order: select,link,parent_end,child_start,allow_equal. Link source identifies current row's predecessor;
target identifies the predecessor row in the SAME table. Fires only when predecessor completion is too late.
A null source link is not an active dependency. Use only with documented execution ordering and verified clocks/units.
unexplained_event: select,context:{select,join},explained_by:[{select,join}].
Root select is the event needing review. Context links this event to its qualifying parent.
Fires when the context qualifies and NONE of the documented explanation relations exists.
Every relation source is a column of the ROOT EVENT, target is a column of the related row.
Encode all documented normal handling/retry exceptions through those relations, not only in prose.
Use actual parent/context key joins for explanations too; a recovery in another transaction does not explain this event.
No arbitrary code/SQL. Null/unknown is never silently false. Require complete capture for absence-based conclusions.
Do not add unrelated missingness conditions to a key or relationship check. Missing input is unavailable, not a violation.
Before responding, compare the positive meaning of your selected operator against the cited contract and your own reason.

This is OFFLINE REUSABLE RULE RECOMMENDATION, not just classifying the supplied sample.
Propose checks supported by the documents EVEN WHEN EVERY CURRENT ROW IS VALID.
No-candidate is appropriate when no check is justified, not merely because no violation is observed.
For unexplained-event review, the ROOT select is the problematic EVENT table, not the parent table.
context links that event to its qualifying parent/context. Every explained_by relation links
FROM THE ROOT EVENT to a possible handling/recovery row. Use all documented scope/key components.
A null explanation pointer denotes no relationship when the source document says so; it is not a business violation.
The grammar supplies physical tables and columns, not the correct rule, joins, role or business-code values.
Choose those from the source documents. Do not invent requirements from logical relationship definitions.

Check complete source scope, not just the visually matching event key. A reference can be
scoped by a parent, tenant or partition; preserve EVERY documented scope component in joins.
If a referencing column is on the RELATED row, it joins the ROOT row's identifier to that
related referencing column. The reverse direction answers a different question.
If information is explicitly undocumented, return request_evidence with the specific fact;
do not turn inability to define a check into a claim of normality.
When completeness required for a requested conclusion is absent, explicitly describe the
missing completeness evidence with request_evidence, rather than silently returning no check.
No sample IDs may appear as predicate values. Do not infer a null's business meaning from
its frequency. A null optional backlink is no active relationship ONLY when documented;
otherwise preserve unavailable rather than silently treating uncertainty as absence.


Logical completeness review:
Every select.filter array is a CONJUNCTION: every atom must hold for a row to fire.
Separately required facts are not necessarily conjunctive violations. If a document
requires BOTH A and B, violation is NOT A OR NOT B, not NOT A AND NOT B. The current
filter language has no OR within one array: express independently sufficient
violations as separate candidates, whose alerts are combined by OR. Do not silently
weaken a requirement merely to fit it into one candidate. The same De Morgan logic
applies to permitted alternatives and to explanation relations.
For each multi-atom filter, mentally vary one fact while retaining the other facts:
does the calculated firing condition still represent the cited meaning? A current
all-valid sample cannot establish that a logically incomplete detector is correct.
Keep only conditions actually supported by the supplied source. Do not invent an
obligation merely because its violation would be representable.
Read the supplied capture metadata before requesting capture evidence. Do not ask
again for the identical fact already explicitly provided. Capture completeness is
evidence about observation coverage, not an assertion that a business obligation
exists. Distinguish missing business meaning from missing source coverage.
Do not require complete-family capture for every kind of check by default. A
documented NOT-NULL obligation is different from an unavailable input to another
calculation: a known null in an observed row can itself violate that explicit
obligation. A known invalid code or observed duplicate can likewise be positive
local evidence without seeing all other events. Preserve unknown inputs and the
executor's uncertainty about unseen related records; require complete capture
when a conclusion actually depends on absence or full-family observation.
When a coverage pass finds no additional supported check, return zero candidates
with an accurate no_candidate_reason; do not manufacture an evidence request just
to keep the candidates list nonempty.
